description: This file defines a custom Doctrine ORM function 'TimeDiff' to calculate time differences between two datetime expressions, outputting the result in specified units (seconds, minutes, hours). It extends Doctrine's FunctionNode and implements parsing and SQL generation logic.

classes.name: TimeDiff
classes.description: Represents a custom Doctrine ORM function to calculate time differences between two datetime expressions with selectable units (seconds, minutes, hours).

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the function input, extracting two datetime expressions and the desired output unit (minute, hour, default seconds).

methods.name: getSql
methods.description: Generates the SQL fragment to compute the time difference in the specified units using MySQL functions.
